en.quote: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
en.speaker: king

he.quote: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־לָהּ הַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר אֲבָל אִשָּֽׁה־אַלְמָנָה אָנִי וַיָּמָת אִישִֽׁי
he.speaker: הַמֶּלֶךְ

en.5: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.
